title: Lithuania's Twin Stress Test: Stubborn Inflation and Security Fears Put… · 29 Aug
keywords: Lithuania, inflation, eurozone, fiscal policy, GDP growth, defence spending, infrastructure resilience, power outage, drone threats, hybrid warfare, Baltic states, European Union, eastern flank, cost of living, energy security
notes: Lithuania is expanding at a pace that most European economies would envy, but growth alone is failing to reassure households squeezed by some of the eurozone's highest inflation. At the same time, a major storm blackout and warnings of drone provocations from the east have turned infrastructure resilience into an urgent political question. Together, the two pressures are defining what it means to govern a frontline EU state in 2026.
